title: Antenna 2 use against distance
finding: Antenna 2 share rises from 0 in the first 1 km to 35 percent beyond 5 km.
chip: Gemini, Mono and Lite on one carry, 5.3 km ride

caveats.text: Samples are not evenly spread over distance: bins hold 9 to 871 samples, and bins with fewer than 8 are dropped.
Antenna placement and orientation are not recorded.
One unit of each, one ride.

reduction: Share of logged samples with the flag set, in 500 m bins of at least 8 samples.
